label: Précis1993 proposes life composition, event identity and indeterminacy
locator: p.684 proposed answer and p.685 identity/existence indeterminacy
interpretation: The passage states the proposed life-only criterion, describes particle flow through a self-maintaining event and explicitly makes diachronic object identity depend on numerical identity of that event. It then allows indeterminacy in life-event identity and life constitution. The operational reciprocal rule in the new Lean module is an analyst proposal, not attributed to this passage. No sufficiency of metabolic closure, universal branching identity, soul doctrine or defeat of rivals is attributed.
attribution: The passage states this proposed composition/persistence account and its admitted indeterminacy, which is the statement.
